answer: Escrow the payment, release it only after a grade lands, then vest 70 percent of it over 20 epochs. A task, not an address, is the unit of trust, so a whisper of activity on 400 keys unlocks nothing until each key finishes its own work. Detail that matters: the wander of a payout across epochs is 5 percent per close, slower than an ocean of fake volume can be recycled.
